pattern: Layered REST API with cache-aside and async event pipeline

api_gateway.role: Entry point — rate limiting, TLS termination, routing

url_service.role: Core business logic — shorten, resolve, validate URLs

cache.role: Hot-path lookup cache — code → original_url mapping
cache.strategy: Cache-aside: read cache first, fallback to DB, populate on miss

database.role: Durable store for URL records and analytics events

analytics_worker.role: Async consumer of click events — aggregates stats
analytics_worker.pattern: Fire-and-forget publish on redirect; worker persists to DB

redirect: Lookup code in Redis (cache hit → 302 redirect, ~1ms)
On cache miss → lookup PostgreSQL → populate Redis → 302 redirect
Publish click event to async queue (non-blocking)

scalability.stateless_api: Multiple API replicas behind load balancer
scalability.cache_layer: Redis reduces DB load by ~95% for hot URLs
scalability.db_scaling: Read replicas for analytics queries; primary for writes
scalability.async_analytics: Decoupled from redirect path — no latency impact
